# TPC-DS-OBT Q18

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  item_i_item_id,
  bill_addr_ca_country,
  bill_addr_ca_state,
  bill_addr_ca_county,
  AVG(CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1,
  AVG(CAST(list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2,
  AVG(CAST(coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3,
  AVG(CAST(sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4,
  AVG(CAST(net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5,
  AVG(CAST(bill_customer_c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6,
  AVG(CAST(bill_cdemo_cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
    AND item_sk = item_i_item_sk
    AND bill_cdemo_sk = bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk
    AND bill_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk
    AND bill_cdemo_cd_gender = '0'
    AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = '0'
    AND bill_customer_c_current_cdemo_sk = bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk
    AND bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk
    AND bill_customer_c_birth_month IN (2, 4, 1, 5, 8, 3)
    AND sold_date_d_year = 1998
    AND bill_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3', '3', '3', '3', '3')
  )
  AND channel = 'catalog'
GROUP BY
  ROLLUP (
    item_i_item_id,
    bill_addr_ca_country,
    bill_addr_ca_state,
    bill_addr_ca_county
  )
ORDER BY
  bill_addr_ca_country,
  bill_addr_ca_state,
  bill_addr_ca_county,
  item_i_item_id
LIMIT 100
```
